decisions.statement: What tells one generation from another is a value handed in.
The name a generation goes by gives its image, its container and its folder.
That name in capitals gives the variables a caller overrides those by.
The port a generation answers on is the port inside the container too.
A generation with a script that proves the GPU closes by naming that script.
A generation with none closes by naming its folder alone.
A folder two containers both mount is relabelled shared rather than private.
Every generation relabels the same way, so the relabel is no value handed in.
Nothing here asks the index where a recipe sits.

definition: the one body every ComfyUI up script is written from
